dsDescriptionValue.value: The SATellite SEGmentation (SATSEG) dataset is used to benchmark segmentation methods applied to space-based applications. SATSEG consists of 100 color and grayscale pictures of actual spacecraft, and laboratory mockup, captured by visual and thermal cameras. Some of the spacecraft in this dataset include: Cygnus, Dragon, ISS, Space Shuttle, Cubesats, Hubble, Orbital Express, and Radarsat. Also included in SATSEG is manually-produced ground-truth data that provides a binary mask for each image.

publicationCitation.value: Shi, J.-F., and Ulrich, S., “Uncooperative Spacecraft Pose Estimation using Monocular Monochromatic Images,” AIAA Journal of Spacecraft and Rockets. Vol. 58, No. 2, 2021, pp. 284–301.
